description: Creates, changes, or deletes an event in the Mac's calendars, invites people, and answers invitations. action: create (title, start, and end, or all-day dates; calendar, location, notes, url, alarms, repeat, invite are optional), update (id and only the fields to change; moving start keeps the length; invite and uninvite add or remove people by email), delete (id; it can't be undone), respond (id and answer: accept, maybe, or decline an invitation; comment is optional; the organizer is told). invite sends invitations from the calendar's account (iCloud, Google, Exchange). An invitation from someone else can be changed too, but only the Owner's copy changes unless the organizer lets guests change it. For a repeating event, span: this (default) changes the one occurrence, future that one and all later ones. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the Mac's time zone (optionally with Z or ±HH:MM); a date without a time makes an all-day event. An empty text clears a field. Events in read-only calendars (holidays, subscriptions) can't be changed.

alarms.description: Alerts, in minutes before the start, like [10, 60]; [] for none

answer.description: For respond: the Owner's answer to the invitation

calendar.description: The calendar (name or id; default the Mac's default calendar)

comment.description: For respond: a note to the organizer

end.description: When it ends (default an hour after the start; for all-day, the last day)

id.description: The event's id, from calendar_find (for update and delete)

invite.description: Email addresses to invite (create and update)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

repeat.description: How it repeats; none stops repeating

repeat_count.description: Or: how many times in all

repeat_every.description: Repeat every this many days, weeks, … (default 1)

span.description: For a repeating event: this occurrence or this and later ones

uninvite.description: Email addresses to take off the event (update)

name: calendar_change
title: Change Calendar Events
